events.title: Contentful founded
events.summary: Sascha Konietzke and Paolo Negri founded Contentful in Berlin in 2013 — an API-first headless CMS for delivering content to any channel.
events.about: Contentful stores structured content as JSON via REST and GraphQL APIs — marketers edit in a web app while developers fetch content in React, mobile, or IoT apps. It pioneered the headless CMS category alongside Strapi and Sanity, decoupling content from presentation.

narrative.whyChosen: Contentful helped define headless CMS: content as data, not page templates.
narrative.whyImportant: API-first content delivery enabled omnichannel apps and JAMstack frontends.
narrative.problemSolved: Traditional CMSs tied content to HTML pages, blocking mobile and multi-platform delivery.

events.title: Prismic founded
events.summary: Sadek Drobi and Guillaume Bort founded Prismic in Paris in 2013 — a SaaS headless CMS with a visual page builder and slice-based content model.
events.about: Prismic's Slices let developers define reusable page sections in code while marketers compose layouts visually — integrated with Next.js, Nuxt, and SvelteKit. It became a mainstream headless CMS for marketing sites and landing pages.

narrative.whyChosen: Prismic's slice model bridged developer-defined components and marketer-friendly editing.
narrative.whyImportant: Reusable content slices influenced page-builder patterns across headless CMSs.
narrative.problemSolved: Marketing teams needed visual page building without abandoning modern JavaScript frontends.
